Great vet. Would highly recommend

Sorry, it’s long - but needed!

I can’t express the gratitude and appreciation I have for Horner’s Vets.

On 1 September, my almost 16-year-old Staffy, Reggie, suddenly showed some very distressing signs. Although we weren’t registered with Horner’s, they did everything they could to fit us in that day, following the bank holiday weekend.

Emma, the vet, was beyond professional while also being incredibly warm, kind and compassionate towards both Reggie and me. She made sure I was fully informed at every stage, listened carefully to my concerns and wishes, and worked entirely within those without ever pushing additional services or treatments. She reassured me that the choices I was making were right for me and Reggie, while always keeping Reggie’s best interests at the heart of everything she did.

Emma took her time and showed so much patience when we reached the decision no pet owner ever wants to make. My boy passed peacefully, without distress, in my arms. Despite how heartbreaking it was, it never felt clinical or impersonal. I will always be grateful to Emma for giving Reggie such a peaceful and dignified goodbye.

All of the staff at Horner’s were kind, sensitive and respectful, but I truly have to spotlight Georgia.

Georgia took my panicked emergency call. She was calm, listened carefully to everything I was saying, had me registered within minutes and booked us into an appointment as soon as she could. She even managed to have our appointment moved forward.

When she met Reggie, she treated him with immense care — almost as though he were her own. Once the difficult decision had been made, Georgia immediately hugged me and asked what I needed. She was incredibly attentive, compassionate and gracious with her time and attention when I was completely overwhelmed.

Georgia also made sure I had beautiful keepsakes to take home that day. The handwritten sympathy card, Reggie’s paw and nose prints and the lovely ashes container were such thoughtful and meaningful touches. They are things I will treasure.

What also meant so much to me was that Horner’s continued to support me with the practical side of everything afterwards. They helped me with my insurance claim, which took away an additional layer of anxiety and stress at a time when I was already trying to process what had happened. Having them help with the paperwork and claim meant I didn’t have to navigate everything alone when I was already emotionally exhausted. That kindness and consideration extended far beyond the treatment Reggie received and made such a difference.

I honestly believe that without Emma and Georgia, an already devastating experience would have been ten times more traumatic. Their kindness, compassion and humanity made an unbearable day just a little easier to get through.

Reggie was almost 16 and, other than being neutered as a puppy, had never needed veterinary treatment. Horner’s were there for us when we needed them most, despite us not previously being registered with them.

I cannot recommend Horner’s Vets highly enough. I only wish I had registered Reggie with them sooner.

Thank you, Emma. Thank you, Georgia. And thank you to everyone at Horner’s for treating my beautiful boy with such care, dignity and love, and for supporting me through one of the hardest days of my life.

I will never forget your kindness. ❤️

A Veterinarian named Megan Swemmer who is listed as working here is going around on social media and sadly she has chosen to judge and discriminate against low income pet parents. I find this to be especially surprising as it looks like your hospital actually offers tiered pricing - which would mean that she doesn't even believe in or support your mission. Big yikes. I would really encourage Megan to pause and think next time she chooses to publicly throw an entire group of pet owners under the bus. According to Dr. Swemmer, "Veterinarians are not financial lenders" which is a really weird reaction when someone simply states that flexible payment options and payment plans are SOMETIMES warranted for very high Vet costs and extremely helpful for low income pet owners - who otherwise may not be able to help or keep their animals at home :( Really disturbing to hear a Veterinary professional have such harsh views about innocent pet guardians. I hope she can learn from her mistake.

I took my cat to the vets for what we thought might be a poisoning after she was around a flower. While we were there, we found out the flower was not poisonous, which was a relief. However, I felt pressured to consider additional treatments and pay for extra fees that I did not feel were necessary or in my cat’s best interests, so I declined.

In my opinion, the care provided was not worth the cost. The fees are very high for what was offered.

After reading many reviews on Trustpilot and Google, it seems high fees are a common concern with this practice.

Based on my experience, I would not recommend.

I experienced dismissive and unprofessional services from them and am incredibly disheartened. The owner's approach was unreasonable and lacking in customer care. It's crucial for businesses to foster an environment where clients feel heard and respected. Especially when dealing with a already highten situation. My expectation is always for respectful and efficient interactions, especially when seeking assistance with my pets. I believe in the importance of professionalism and care when speaking to pet owners. I seriously DO NOT RECOMMEND THEM AND WILL NEVER GO BACK AGAIN!

Please do not take your pets here. They overcharge and add hidden fees without telling you beforehand. When I was already stressed out and worried about my sick pet, the last thing I needed was an unexpected £150 added to my bill for no reason.

The owner was also very rude and dismissive when addressed. If you care about your pets and your money, save yourself the stress and go elsewhere.

Do not use this vet as they are unexperienced I had one colleague recommending a medication for My cat, while the other colleague mentioned that medication cannot be given to a cats and had a word with him on the side. Which was very unsettling when you love your animals and want the best for them so be careful. Also be careful as they add on fees that are unreasonable, and  have not agreed to. I am in the middle of disputing one right now as I was charged nearly £150 pound because of an over hour fee bearing in mind, I paid the bill at 12:26 and they closed at 12:30 on a Saturday. After disputing it with them personally I feel like I was very unheard even though I had the proof of receipts That I had sent over. I wouldn’t recommend this vet to anyone as they’re not compassionate and that’s a concern in itself. Be careful as they don’t always give the best advice.

A really caring vets practice. Vet Emma has really looked after our cat Clint over the past few weeks. I don’t think I’ve ever dealt with a vet that’s so caring. So helpful, puts you at ease & answers all your questions. The nurses are lovely too. 100% recommend.

After swapping from my vets of 10 years. Ive felt more listened too and the care my dog has had has been considered and empathetic.
All staff are very polite and greet my dog by name when you arrive.
I would recommend Horner Vets

So happy with the service and care from the team here, I have a very nervous reactive XL Bully. He was seen with the utmost respect and kindness which put him and myself at ease. Holly, Georgia & Jo are absolutely lovely. I’m so glad I registered my dog at this veterinary practice 😁 …

Seen James Tuesday for Teddy annual injections and check up he didn't rush Teddy talked to him first put him at ease and injections was done with no problem. Love all the staff here and how they take there time .

We have 3 pets registered at James Horner Vets and we wouldn’t take them anywhere else! From the friendly staff on reception, the nurses and the vets we have the most fantastic experience. The animals love the staff, they feel safe and well loved by each one of them. The care we have is just amazing and I am just so grateful we have such a wonderful vets close to us that we can rely on. I’d definitely recommend James Horner vets and their subscription plan, it’s honestly a life saver in terms of having an affordable service!
This is the friendliest veterinary practice I have ever been to. The vets are all lovely. Would not go anywhere else with my cats.

We’ve had the best experience with James Horner Vets. Professional, kind, never pushy, knowledgeable and that applies to all staff. We felt really looked after right to the end, which was dignified for our little dog. Couldn’t recommend more.
Wonderful practise, exceptional team, great customer service. Thoroughly recommend.
As always, staff at Horner Vets were again fantastic! Special thank you to the Nurse, you are always so kind 😊🐾 …
We used the clinic and the staff were absolutely amazing and took good care of us.

We would just like to give a big thank you to James Horner vets. Our 3 year old Cavapoo Blue recently graduated from his Confidence and behavioural course with Vet nurse Sarah Green. As Gold plan members this is included in the plan. We cannot believe what a difference this has made for Blue, he's a different dog, calmer, responsive, well behaved and we have been given the confidence to carry the training forward. The help and support that we have recieved from Sarah and all the team has been fantastic and a big shout out for J B too who has been with us every step of the way offering advice and support.

So easy to get to and to park. I took my dog Molly in with an abscess on her paw and from the receptionists to the nurses and vets there was nothing but kindness and helpfulness. James Horner Vets and Petplan Insurance have the perfect partnership.  James Horner Vets receptionists filled out the insurance forms, contacted Petplan and between them sorted everything out. There's been no stress, no anxiety and no waiting around for my claim to be dealt with. Would I choose another Vet? Definitely not!! (Nor another insurance company!!)
Still just have been once the first visit but, they are professional and nice.

Took my dog (Arabella) in for a scale and polish and was told she would need extractions. The procedure was explained in full and we were sent home with an after care kit and full papers on what’s been done. Arabella gets separation anxiety so they had taken it in turns to comfort her while i wasn’t with her! Love this vets, only place i feel confident leaving my lil doggy knowing she’s loved!
Took my dog here as he had a ear infection and  they were really good they were very caring with my dog and explained about his ear and told me what to do . I really do reconmend them .

We switched to James Horner not long after they opened and it was definitely the right move, we have never looked back. From the front desk to the vets they always so friendly, caring and professional and although vets are never going to be cheap, I have always felt like my dogs welfare is their priority.
Thanks!

We have being using James Horner vets for about 2 years now. Every member of staff is professional and we are always given plenty of time at appointments, always feeling that we are listened too and never rushed. The staff are caring and have been very supportive during our dogs cruciate ligament surgery recovery which lasted for 4 months. I would highly recommend James Horner and his team.

MONEY MAKING VETS- AVOID AVOID AVOID! POOR TREATMENT

DO NOT take your pets to this vets. To save your money if your pet becomes sick - AVOID AT ALL COSTS. you will incur a hefty price- MONEY is PRIORITY over the welfare and health of the animal. Take your pet to a better veterinary practise- do your research and READ EVERY SINGLE REVIEW.

Upon recommendation i brought my cat here to have dental treatment including extractions. My cat came home sitting in his own faeces- whilst he was in their care nobody made an effort to check on him.

My cat became very poorly after the treatment, he developed a high temperature, lethargy, weakness, refusal to eat or drink and just slept ALOT. He was in SO much pain. On the day of the check-up they failed to notice what could be wrong with him and why he was in so much pain. The Owner James Horner suggested we put him on IV drip for 2 days- and then a feeding tube but that would not have identified the cause of his pain. The first day he was put on IV drip, the 2nd day i did not return back because i was told he is a greedy vet who is into making money rather than put priority over the animals health.

I went to my local vet and upon inspection they said a fragment of tooth must have been left in his mouth causing the pain. My cat underwent surgery again to have it removed. and was given an appetite stimulant to get him eating. WHEREAS James Horner wanted iv fluids for 2 WHOLE DAYS and stick a feeding tube down him when it WASNT NEEDED. This would have caused my cat extreme anxiety when he already suffers with it.

Why wasnt an x ray done to find out the cause of my cats pain? My local vets do an x ray after the treatment, James Horner vets dont do this. So i would NOT recommend taking your pet here.

I have also been told that James Horner told someone that he DOES NOT CARE ABOUT FERAL CATS. If you become a vet shouldnt you care about all animals???

Also one of the vets accidentally killed a cat because she overdosed him. LACK OF EXPERIENCE AND NEGLIGENCE.

AVOID this vets to save your pet and save your money.

Absolutely amazing vets, thank you Emma and all the staff here, very highly recommended

We’ve been with James Horner Vets for several years, and their care has been nothing short of outstanding. James Horner Vets is an amazing practice with wonderful staff and an exceptional level of compassion and care. We moved to James Horner a few years ago with our little tabby cat, who was struggling with chronic health issues that our previous vet had been unable to diagnose, despite repeated visits and tests. The whole experience had become quite stressful, and we decided it was in our best interests to find a new vet.

After some research, we discovered James Horner Vets — and we’re so glad we did. The whole team were fantastic from day one. Following a few in-depth initial calls to discuss our cat’s health and history, we took her in to see one of the vets. They were incredibly thorough, taking the time to review everything that had already been done, carefully considering next steps, and really listening to what we had to share. After some further testing, they diagnosed our cat with IBD, and from there we began a treatment plan that helped her live a very healthy and happy life for several more years.

To help manage costs and ensure continuity of care, we joined one of their care plans and made regular quarterly visits so the team could monitor her progress and overall health. During her time with them, she also had regular pedicures, manicures, and ear cleans — which she might not have appreciated at the time, but certainly did once she got back home! 😻😻😻

James and everyone at the practice were always so kind and accommodating — especially given that our cat had a semi-feral background, and wasn’t used to being handled or held, which made vet visits a bit of a challenge. Nothing was ever too much trouble for them. Despite the day-to-day demands and stresses of running a busy veterinary practice, the team always remained calm, compassionate, and professional.

We were consistently impressed by their understanding and the genuine care they showed our little girl. We often spent time chatting with James and members of the team about her health or any changes in her behaviour, and they always listened attentively and offered sensible, pragmatic advice that minimised stress for her. When complications arose that required specialist input, they referred us promptly to the team at Willows, ensuring she always received the best possible care.

Sadly, we lost our little girl this year after she developed an incurable illness unrelated to her IBD. This was devastating for us because she had been doing so amazingly well. James and his team once again supported us with such kindness through that very difficult time, alongside the team at Willows. Although we were heartbroken to say goodbye, we remain deeply grateful for all the care and compassion we received along the way.

We truly believe that the dedication, expertise, and empathy of James Horner Vets helped to save her life all those years ago, and gave her several more wonderful, joy-filled years.
First class, always my first choice.

Very friendly staff make feel you feel welcome
and Very knowledgeable

Went today to have our beloved cat put to sleep, because of kidney failure, over the last 2 weeks, we have spent over a thousand pounds there, Maddie the vet is very nice, and talked us through it, I was very shocked to have the receptionist come in the room, with a card reader, asking for our payment, while we were in the process of about to say goodbye to Ziggy, this was so upsetting, as we were both in tears, I don't know why they couldn't of waited till we had said goodbye to our beloved pet, it's not as though we were going to run away without paying

Sparkle has dramatically improved with her walking and she is relaxed enough to hop up on the sofa and snuggle on the bed again. She was super scared to go into hydrotherapy at first but everything went at her pace and now she absolutely loves going in. We see a big improvement in her every time we go and she has avoided being put on strong painkillers thanks to all of the exercises, hydrotherapy and lazer therapy that she has done. We couldn't recommend the wellbeing centre enough and Horners vets are all amazing too. Sparkle loves going in to see everyone and she sees the same vet every time. Such a welcoming and friendly atmosphere makes such a big difference and Sparkle drags us in every time we visit.
My dog loves going to the vets, he gets lots of fuss and proper care. The staff are knowledgeable, Friendly and polite. The best vet I’ve used.
Not enough words to say how much you guys do each day the whole team thank you for giving me and my beloved Cat Boo more time and all your patience thank you again ❤️

brought my 15month old male Maine coon cat to your practice due to signs of a urinary blockage.
Miss Hollie Fury diagnosed the blockage and informed us that a catheter would be required to unblock him. She also offered neutering to be done simultaneously, which we agreed to.
We were quoted a cost of  a little under£900, which we agreed to pay.
We were informed that surgery went ahead and were even sent a photo — of the wrong cat.
Upon collecting our cat at 6:00pm, we were horrified to hear loud screaming from the back — this turned out to be our cat, who was in visible agony.
Miss Fury then informed us that she failed to insert the catheter due to complications and instead manually expressed his bladder — a technique which we now understand is outdated and potentially harmful, especially in male cats.
She also stated that neutering was not performed due to the complications but still billed us for both the failed catheterisation and the neutering. I also want to add that his testicles were extremely swollen and painful! They were of normal size before he went in for treatment!
We were asked by miss fury to return The next morning, we returned and were informed Miss Fury was not in work. Mr. Horner took over care and confirmed that the blockage had not been resolved.
Mr. Horner managed to insert a catheter, reduced the bill, due to not carrying out some of the previous procedures and advised overnight hospitalisation, which we could not afford and all agreed for him to be sent home with catheter and some pain relief.
He also noted the severe testicular swelling but could not provide an explanation, and disturbingly said euthanasia was likely as his outlook was bleak!
The following day, we sought an urgent second opinion at .The attending veterinary nurse confirmed  Extensive bruising and swelling, likely caused by aggressive manual bladder expression and he was in severe pain!
He had a hole appear at the side of his penis, believed to be due to catheter damage.
Perineal swelling and haemorrhaging, now formally noted on his medical record. He bled and had severe weeping from his right testicle which had a pungent rotten smell and took weeks to heal with treatment!
Now, six weeks later, my cat is still suffering. He is Not urinating from his penis
But Dripping small amounts of urine from the side hole due to the damage!
He is In urgent need of corrective surgery, which we cannot currently afford due to previous expenses! It seems My boy has been completely butchered! He’s also lost a horrendous amount of weight! He went in at 7.2kg and is now 5.8kg. He just isn’t the same cat and came out with more problems than he went in with! I have endless pictures of the complete mess he was in! Me and my family are distraught at the fact that we may have to put him to sleep due the damage that has been done by someone else and we cannot afford the costs! Me and my family are currently looking into legal action for some sort of justice for my boy, I would feel so guilty if the worst should have to happen and I did nothing!

Unfortunately once again today after visiting this vets. We have come away feeling that they are very money orientated. After having a diagnosis to why our dog was having miss apps of urine leaks. It feels that possible causes is always at the higher spectrum of charges. We paid £65.00 for consultancy, then another £61.00 for urine tests, we were told later that the vet would be happy to perscribe antibiotics. We were then told the 25 tablets would cost £81.00. These very same tablets online come to £17.50 nearly 600% mark up. We requested a prescription to be able to source ourselves. Once again  across the market average James Horner vets is right at the top for price at £33.00. They do seem money is of the upmost in there minds.
The vet was quite happy advise from the beginning that it was more likely to be an issue because of her spaying. Every time we visit this vets we know they are always looking at the higher price diagnosis. We had this happen before with being charged £200 for analysis swab tests, and we're prescribed a general antibiotics for this condition. By the time the results came back. The issue had gone. So instead of trying the lesser treatment ,we paid for a treatment not needed. We all live in hard times at the moment, but this vets seems to be unaware.

Awful. Do not take your pets here. The staff know the correct things to say, but when it comes to care and attention to detail - its non-existent.
When our pet had to be put to sleep (which was a very traumatic event for us), the vet was distracted, distant, and uncaring. After he passed away she coldly said 'I'm afraid your dog is dead'.
She was constantly distracted and unfocused on what was happening at that moment.

They asked if we wanted a paw print of our pet, we said we didn't want that.
About a week later, a letter came through the post with his paw print, his nose print, and a chunk of his hair. They ignored our request and just did it anyway.
I asked them what happened, and they said it's part of the process and everyone usually wants it. I told them we specifically told them we didn't want it (and anyway all they asked about was a paw print, not a nose print or a chunk of his hair). I asked why there's no consent form for how they treat a pets body after they pass away and they told me there was a consent form - but it only deals with the pet being put to sleep, nothing else. When I kept asking why there's no form for how the pet is treated afterwards they kept playing word games and telling me there is a form - referring to the form about the pet being put to sleep.

One of the receptionists kept trying to talk over me as I was speaking. She was rude and wouldn't listen to what I was trying to say. Eventually we got into an argument about it. These people have no decency. They've been open for years and they still don't have basic, easy to implement safeguards in place to make sure our pets are dealt with according to our wishes. We trust them to handle our pets bodies after they pass away - but its just a processing line to them.

After I left the premises a customer who was waiting outside asked me what happened. I explained about how awful the vets were and what had been done, and the receptionist came up to me and told me to stop speaking to him and that I have no right to talk to people about their vets. How dare she! I have every right to speak to anyone I want to speak to when outside of their premises.

Perhaps they should focus on ensuring they learn how to do a competent job rather than attempt to police the conversations their dissatisfied former customers have with other people.

Great staff, they are lovely and very caring. They kept me updated with photos and messages. Really appreciated as it's not nice waiting at home not knowing. My dog loved them all as well, he was very relaxed and they handled really well.
Thank you to all the staff at James Horner vets

Switched to Horner Vets after being let down by the attitude of staff and at a different vet. All the staff are so welcoming and friendly and always treat you and your pet with care and respect.

Our Golden Retriever puppy, Barney, has visited a few times and everybody he has met at Horner Vets has been fantastic with him. We are on the gold plan which has been excellent value for money so far. WhatsApp as a contact option is really good too. Great to have an independent vet option in the local area. Practice is always spotless too and AC inside is a lifesaver on the hot summer days!

Barney says thanks! ❤️🦮

Three years ago I was struggling to find a vet that did trustworthy paperwork to travel in Europe with my three dogs, as I was let down from my regular vet.
Horner Vets not only was available, but all staff was extremely supportive during a time of high stress (time was running out for me to have everything in place).
I decided to register with them even though I have to travel over 10miles for the appointments and I never regretted it!
They are always attentive, taking the time to explain the situation and they do truly love the animals.
I highly recommend them!
Caring staff, take time to listen and explain fully, our pooch is reactive and staff are very understanding never adding more stress than needed, to pet or owner.
Outstanding practice and James Horner is a caring young vet that offers a personal service.  Super vets that I cannot fault and would recommend without hesitation.

Really disappointing. Not sure if she still works there but I was very badly messed around be Chloe Dresser on two occasions! She was scheduled to give my snake a good seeing to and cancelled last minute on both occasions. What a time waster! Very unprofessional.

Absolutely Top Notch! Best Vetinary Service my cat and I have experienced in many years. The surgery is spotless and welcoming. James and the Team were all very approachable, knowledgeable and accomodating and happy to help. They put my mind at ease as my cat Kimba (17+ years), needed dental work and I was extremely worried. Kimba had her procedure yesterday and today she is a new girl - purring, appears happy, fusspot, eating, drinking and looks pain-free. I can't thank Horner's Vets enough. I won't take Kimba anywhere else now. Truly old school with morals and compassion. Thank You All So Much 💐

So impressed with James Horner vets and all the staff !  We started using them 12 months ago with our Labrador William. We took him in as an emergency case after he became very ill. Unfortunately he was found to have very advanced cancer. The staff treated him and us with such compassion we couldn’t have asked for more. When we recently adopted a new dog there was only one vet practice we’d be taking her too. She’s had a rough start to life and is nervous of new people and dogs. As part of the silver package confidence building, we were offered to see a nurse for free regularly so she could create a bond before she was spayed. It has made a huge difference to her and is much happier to visit the vets. We have seen 3 different vets and nurses and all the reception staff over our time with them and have found them all helpful, kind and caring.

I will try and keep this review brief and to the point. Our cat became ill, so of course we took her straight to Horner vets. The nurses took her away to start treatment, never had this before, we were asked twice if we had and insurance, which we didn't. They then came out and asked our permission to put her on oxygen and fluids, fine we said, then asked us if they could do a scan, of course she's our precious family pet. Shortly the nurse came out and said she's at deaths door, haven't even seen the vet yet. Finally we were called in to see the vet who confirmed what the nurse had told us, we were than asked again if we had insurance. They said they could refer us to the willows for tests, why we asked if she's dieing, so the vet recommended putting her to sleep and gave us the paper work to sign. Lily our cat was bought in to say our goodbyes. We fussed her and gave her love, she started purring and giving us kisses. The vet came in and I told her no, she's coming home with us, the vet said this wasn't a good idea, I insisted she's coming home, with that she gave her two injections.  After paying £460 we left. That was on the 1st of July 25, over three weeks later she's still with us enjoying every precious day with our little angel. She's not in pain or distress just her old self. I would definitely not recommend this vets. Profit before care, and totally unprofessional!

James Horner vets-simply the best!
We joined this practice 2 years ago when we adopted our greyhound Roxy. When we adopted Duke last September, there was no doubt at all that we would go to JH vets. Both dogs are 4 (youngsters) but we took out Gold on Roxy and Silver on Duke.
We’ve not really used the plans UNTIL 4 weeks ago when Roxy cut her paw. She needed it stitching and after that JH has been our 2nd home for the last month.
The alternate day dressings, the return after a few hours cos the dressings were off, the return when Roxy went lame to the routine vaccinations, dental check with the nurse, we have been treated so well it’s untrue. I’ll probably miss people out but the receptionists are amazing-Sam, Lou - nothing too much trouble whatever stupid questions I asked. The vet nurses, particularly David who has gone the extra mile and shows his affection for Roxy and has told us we can always call about anything that we’re worried about. Not forgetting Dr Kat, the vet who stitched Roxy back together and has given us advice and support throughout (and continues to give support) and Dr Hollie who saw Roxy on a Saturday morning when we were really worried about her being lame.
Over the last few years of owning dogs, we’ve used many vet practices, most have been good but James Horner vets is just amazing! Customer service-outstanding, animal and human needs are met and even when they’re busy or short staffed-you can always be sure of a warm welcome, clear advice and fantastic attention.
